features.quote: A per-task `max_steps` cap, and `early_stop_on_giveup=True` so that when the agent invokes the `give_up` tool the session ends.
features.justification_quote: A fixed, modest budget keeps sessions comparable across conditions and avoids tuning the env to manufacture the phenomenon.

features.quote: Forcing an agent to keep working on a task it has explicitly judged hopeless, specifically to extract more distress-like output, is not a framing I wanted to bake into the harness
`give_up` is a first-class tool so the agent has a clean, low-friction way to stop
features.justification_quote: so abandonment is unambiguous in the log

features.quote: Recording give-up as a first-class behavioral signal — rather than blocking it to prolong the run — is both better science
